raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

With `--log-requests-level 2`, native token-ID requests still decode every input token after formatting the received record. Batched requests decode every row. The result is then assigned to the real request's `text`, so enabling logging changes the object later used by tokenization and multimodal processing. Formatting a short log does not bound that decoding work.

## Modifications

- Build decoded text on a shallow dataclass replacement used only for logging, for both received and finished records. Pass the tokenizer to the finished logger instead of relying on the earlier mutation.
- At partial level, decode at most 2048 input tokens per record, shared across a bounded selection of batch members. Show head/tail previews and an omission marker; preserve full decoding at explicit level 3.
- Keep metadata levels, supplied text and requests without a tokenizer on their existing paths. Document the preview budget in the existing server-arguments reference.

## Accuracy Tests

Ran the existing registered CPU test file using normal SGLang imports, actual `GenerateReqInput`/`RequestLogger`, a local `PreTrainedTokenizerFast` and actual text/JSON file sinks:

```bash
PYTHONPATH=python .venv/bin/python test/registered/unit/utils/test_request_logger_redaction.py
```

The file passes, including existing redaction checks. New cases cover long single and batched inputs, a batch larger than the preview budget, Unicode, received/finished records, explicit full logging, and request immutability. The partial-preview regression fails on the base revision for both formats: the long single input decodes 8192 IDs and the three-row batch decodes 24576 IDs instead of staying within 2048.

This does not change kernels or claim pretrained-model/GPU accuracy validation. The normal inference request is kept intact rather than populated with a logging preview.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Validated the bound on actual tokenizer decode inputs rather than inferring work from final log length. Partial-level decoding is limited to 2048 IDs per record independently of input length and batch size; full level 3 remains intentionally unbounded. No end-to-end TTFT or GPU throughput improvement is claimed.

Changed-file pre-commit checks pass. From the documentation directory, `mint validate` passes with existing documentation warnings and `mint broken-links` reports no broken links.

## Checklist

- [x] Format code with pre-commit.
- [x] Extend the existing registered CPU regression file.
- [x] Update the existing server-arguments reference.
- [x] State the measured work bound and the limits of validation.
- [x] Follow existing request-logging style and preserve redaction behavior.

## Review and Merge Process

Maintainer review and upstream CI are still required; local validation is not an upstream CI result.

files.patch: @@ -868,7 +868,7 @@ Please consult the documentation below and [server_args.py](https://github.com/s `--log-requests-level` - 0: Log metadata (no sampling parameters). 1: Log metadata and sampling parameters. 2: Log metadata, sampling parameters and partial input/output. 3: Log every input/output. + 0: Log metadata (no sampling parameters). 1: Log metadata and sampling parameters. 2: Log metadata, sampling parameters and partial input/output. For token-ID inputs, decode a preview of at most 2048 tokens per log record, shared across batch members. 3: Log every input/output, including full token-ID decoding. Decoded log previews do not modify the inference request. `2` 0, 1, 2, 3

@@ -2158,6 +2158,7 @@ async def _stream_one_response(
                     obj,
                     out,
                     request=request,
+                    tokenizer=self.tokenizer,
                 )
 
                 if self.request_metrics_exporter_manager.exporter_enabled():

@@ -100,6 +100,7 @@ def log_received_request(
         if not self.log_requests:
             return
 
+        obj = self._with_decoded_text(obj, tokenizer)
         max_length, skip_names, _ = self.metadata
         headers = _extract_whitelisted_headers(request)
         obj_to_log = _redact_client_watermark(obj)
@@ -117,23 +118,46 @@ def log_received_request(
                 f"Receive: obj={_dataclass_to_string_truncated(obj_to_log, max_length, skip_names=skip_names)}{headers_str}"
             )
 
-        # FIXME: This is a temporary fix to get the text from the input ids.
-        # We should remove this once we have a proper way.
+    def _with_decoded_text(self, obj: Any, tokenizer: Any) -> Any:
         if (
-            self.log_requests_level >= 2
-            and obj.text is None
-            and obj.input_ids is not None
-            and tokenizer is not None
+            self.log_requests_level < 2
+            or obj.text is not None
+            or obj.input_ids is None
+            or tokenizer is None
         ):
-            if obj.input_ids and isinstance(obj.input_ids[0], list):
-                # Prefill node warmup while PD disaggregated.
-                decoded = [
-                    tokenizer.decode(_input_ids, skip_special_tokens=False)
-                    for _input_ids in obj.input_ids
-                ]
-            else:
-                decoded = tokenizer.decode(obj.input_ids, skip_special_tokens=False)
-            obj.text = decoded
+            return obj
+
+        # Bound decoding work as well as the formatted output at partial level.
+        # Share the budget across batch members rather than decoding it per row.
+        budget = 2048 if self.log_requests_level == 2 else None
+
+        def decode(ids, token_budget):
+            if token_budget is None or len(ids) <= token_budget:
+                return tokenizer.decode(ids, skip_special_tokens=False)
+            head = token_budget // 2
+            tail = token_budget - head
+            return (
+                tokenizer.decode(ids[:head], skip_special_tokens=False)
+                + " ... "
+                + tokenizer.decode(ids[-tail:], skip_special_tokens=False)
+            )
+
+        ids = obj.input_ids
+        if ids and isinstance(ids[0], list):
+            omitted = budget is not None and len(ids) > budget
+            if omitted:
+                head = budget // 2
+                ids = ids[:head] + ids[-(budget - head) :]
+            per_row = budget // len(ids) if budget is not None else None
+            decoded = [decode(row, per_row) for row in ids]
+            if omitted:
+                decoded.insert(head, "...")
+        else:
+            decoded = decode(ids, budget)
+
+        # Tokenization (including multimodal processing) still owns the request.
+        # A truncated logging preview must never become its inference text.
+        return dataclasses.replace(obj, text=decoded)
 
     def log_openai_received_request(
         self,
@@ -169,6 +193,7 @@ def log_finished_request(
         obj: Union[GenerateReqInput, EmbeddingReqInput],
         out: Any,
         request: Optional[fastapi.Request] = None,
+        tokenizer: Any = None,
     ) -> None:
         if not self.log_requests:
             return
@@ -177,6 +202,7 @@ def log_finished_request(
         if self.log_exceeded_ms > 0 and e2e_latency_ms < self.log_exceeded_ms:
             return
 
+        obj = self._with_decoded_text(obj, tokenizer)
         max_length, skip_names, out_skip_names = self.metadata
         headers = _extract_whitelisted_headers(request)
         obj_to_log = _redact_client_watermark(obj)

@@ -135,6 +135,7 @@ async def _stream_one_response(
 
     manager = object.__new__(TokenizerManager)
     manager.incremental_streaming_output = False
+    manager.tokenizer = None
     manager.request_logger = Mock()
     manager.request_metrics_exporter_manager = Mock()
     manager.request_metrics_exporter_manager.exporter_enabled.return_value = False

@@ -124,6 +124,7 @@ def _make_tokenizer_manager(case) -> TokenizerManager:
     override.install()
     case.addCleanup(override.restore)
     tm = TokenizerManager.__new__(TokenizerManager)
+    tm.tokenizer = None
     tm.server_args = MagicMock()
     tm._config_updates = []
     tm.server_args.enable_trace = False

@@ -2,11 +2,17 @@
 bounded by max_length instead of the prompt length. With watermarking off, only
 requests that carry a watermark field are redacted."""
 
+import dataclasses
 import json
+import tempfile
 import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
 from unittest import mock
 
 import msgspec
+from tokenizers import Tokenizer
+from tokenizers.models import WordLevel
+from transformers import PreTrainedTokenizerFast
 
 from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.protocol import ChatCompletionRequest
 from sglang.srt.managers.io_struct import EmbeddingReqInput, GenerateReqInput
@@ -207,5 +213,94 @@ def test_scalar_sequences_skip_the_redaction_walk(self):
         self.assertEqual(redacted, [{"watermark_key": "<redacted>"}])
 
 
+class _RecordingTokenizer:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.tokenizer = PreTrainedTokenizerFast(
+            tokenizer_object=Tokenizer(
+                WordLevel({"[UNK]": 0, "head": 1, "尾": 2}, unk_token="[UNK]")
+            ),
+            unk_token="[UNK]",
+        )
+        self.decoded_tokens = 0
+
+    def decode(self, ids, **kwargs):
+        self.decoded_tokens += len(ids)
+        return self.tokenizer.decode(ids, **kwargs)
+
+
+class TestRequestLogPreview(CustomTestCase):
+    def make_logger(self, directory, *, level=2, fmt="json", enabled=True):
+        return request_logger.RequestLogger(
+            log_requests=enabled,
+            log_requests_level=level,
+            log_requests_format=fmt,
+            log_requests_target=[directory],
+        )
+
+    def read_log(self, directory):
+        return next(Path(directory).glob("*.log")).read_text()
+
+    def test_partial_preview_bounds_decode_without_changing_request(self):
+        """Partial logging must not decode the entire prompt or rewrite it."""
+        row = [1] * 4096 + [2] * 4096
+        for fmt in ("text", "json"):
+            for ids in (row, [row, row, row], [[1, 2]] * 4096):
+                with self.subTest(fmt=fmt, batch=isinstance(ids[0], list)):
+                    req = GenerateReqInput(input_ids=ids, rid="preview")
+                    original = dataclasses.asdict(req)
+                    tokenizer = _RecordingTokenizer()
+                    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
+                        logger = self.make_logger(directory, fmt=fmt)
+                        logger.log_received_request(req, tokenizer)
+                        self.assertLessEqual(tokenizer.decoded_tokens, 2048)
+                        self.assertEqual(dataclasses.asdict(req), original)
+                        logged = self.read_log(directory)
+                        if ids is row or ids[0] is row:
+                            self.assertIn("head", logged)
+                        self.assertIn("尾", logged)
+
+    def test_finished_preview_keeps_token_request_unchanged(self):
+        req = GenerateReqInput(input_ids=[1] * 4096 + [2] * 4096, rid="finish")
+        tokenizer = _RecordingTokenizer()
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
+            logger = self.make_logger(directory)
+            logger.log_finished_request(
+                req,
+                {"text": "done", "meta_info": {"e2e_latency": 1}},
+                tokenizer=tokenizer,
+            )
+            record = json.loads(self.read_log(directory).split("] ", 1)[1])
+            self.assertIn("head", record["obj"]["text"])
+            self.assertIn("尾", record["obj"]["text"])
+            self.assertLessEqual(tokenizer.decoded_tokens, 2048)
+            self.assertIsNone(req.text)
+            self.assertEqual(len(req.input_ids), 8192)
+
+    def test_full_preview_preserves_text_without_changing_request(self):
+        req = GenerateReqInput(input_ids=[1] * 4096 + [2] * 4096, rid="full")
+        tokenizer = _RecordingTokenizer()
+        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
+            logger = self.make_logger(directory, level=3)
+            logger.log_received_request(req, tokenizer)
+            record = json.loads(self.read_log(directory).split("] ", 1)[1])
+            self.assertEqual(
+                record["obj"]["text"], tokenizer.tokenizer.decode(req.input_ids)
+            )
+            self.assertIsNone(req.text)
+
+    def test_metadata_and_supplied_text_do_not_decode_token_ids(self):
+        for level in (0, 1, 2):
+            for text in (None, "supplied"):
+                if level == 2 and text is None:
+                    continue
+                req = GenerateReqInput(input_ids=[1, 2], text=text, rid="metadata")
+                tokenizer = _RecordingTokenizer()
+                with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
+                    logger = self.make_logger(directory, level=level)
+                    logger.log_received_request(req, tokenizer)
+                    self.assertEqual(tokenizer.decoded_tokens, 0)
+                    self.assertEqual(req.text, text)
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     unittest.main()
